children: Blank check company Flag Ship Acquisition said it signed a merger deal which will see it take Bluechip Holdings public.

Bluechip is a Cayman Islands holding company whose businesses include insurance-related customer-acquisition, financial-education, AI-driven online-advertising and data-center services, the companies said.
Following the close of the deal, Bluechip will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of Bluechip Holdings, a newly formed Cayman Islands exempted company and wholly owned subsidiary of Flag Ship.

Shares of the combined company are expected to be listed on the Nasdaq. The board of the combined company will consist of Ming Zhang, who is the chief executive officer of Bluechip, one director designated by Flag Ship, and three directors expected to satisfy Nasdaq independence requirements, according to the companies.
Flag Ship Acquisition filed for its initial public offering in November 2021. At that time, the company said it intended to focus on businesses that have a connection to the Asian market.
